newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index slightly down in higher trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index slightly down in higher trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange on Wednesday closed slightly down in trade boosted by the occasional market, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 596.76 from 597.27 on Tuesday.
Trade volume was 3.10 million dinars against 1.27 million dinars.
Most of the trade was on the occasional market where 19,000 shares of Societe Touristique Oceana changed hands in a single contract of 1.9 million dinars.
BIAT bank was up 1.2 dinar to 63.2 dinars.
Banque du Sud was down 7.78 dinars to 22.15 dinars on the exchange of 50 shares. Amen bank eased 1.67 dinar to 54 dinars. ($=0.97 dinar)
